title: Collab: 'Start collaborating' doesn't update the host's browser URL to the room link
description:
FIXED (task 1354). The host's address bar now becomes the shareable room link on Start/Join (Figma/Docs model), and is cleared on Leave.

IMPLEMENTATION:
- NEW packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/collabUrl.ts — pure module (injectable Window for tests): writeCollabFragment(link) sets the #room=...&k=... fragment via history.replaceState (NOT pushState — page state, not navigation; keeps secret out of back/forward history), preserving origin+path+query; clearCollabFragment() strips it ONLY when the current hash parses as a collab link (an unrelated router hash is left untouched).
- CollabContext.tsx wires it at the single session touch point: start()/join() call writeCollabFragment(s.link); leave() and the unmount teardown call clearCollabFragment(). collabSession.ts/collabLink.ts stay DOM-free.
- Share dialog Copy button kept. No auto-join-on-load: parseCollabLink is still invoked ONLY from the dialog's explicit Join; nothing reads location.hash at mount, so our own written fragment is never double-handled / silently re-joined.
- Exported from collab/index.ts.

VERIFY:
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build: green.
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run: 96 files / 1150 tests PASS (0 fail; no 1207-fixture failures appeared).
- pnpm --filter @flash/collab run test -- --run: 4 files / 28 tests PASS.
- NEW gate collab/__tests__/collabUrl.test.ts (6 tests): 5 pure-helper cases (replaceState used + history.state preserved; secret only in fragment; single-# replace of a pre-existing fragment; clears OUR collab fragment; leaves a non-collab hash untouched) + 1 jsdom integration through the real CollabProvider+CollabControls proving Start sets window.location.hash to the share link and Leave clears it. jsdom gotcha: replaceState rejects cross-origin URLs, so the test resets to a same-origin path.
- docs/37-collab.md updated (new §12.1a Address-bar reflection); CLAUDE.md learnings appended.
